course.title: Resettlement Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose a person is to resettle and receive compensation. He/she owns 3 bigha agri-land with standing crop (rice), 0.5 bigha pond with fish, 0.2 bigha of high land surrounding the pond, a house (pucca) on 0.25 bigha land, 0.5 bigha of mango-forest. Explain how the compensation will be estimated and who will be responsible for the estimation. Also estimate the compensation cost with assumed data.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
